ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products pr LEFT JOIN users u ON pr.seller_id = u.id
pr.status = 1
AND (pr.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR pr.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR pr.tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

SELECT COUNT(*) AS published, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS onSale, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sold, COALESCE(SUM(view_count), 0) AS totalViews, COALESCE(SUM(like_count), 0) AS totalLikes, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS gmv FROM products WHERE seller_id = #{sellerId} AND status IN (1, 2, 3)

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, SUM(view_count) AS views, SUM(like_count) AS likes, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sales FROM products WHERE seller_id = #{sellerId} AND status IN (1, 2, 3) AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY day

SELECT c.name AS categoryName, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(p.price), 0) AS gmv FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.seller_id = #{sellerId} AND p.status IN (1, 2, 3) GROUP BY c.id, c.name
SELECT name, price, view_count AS views, like_count AS likes FROM products WHERE seller_id = #{sellerId} AND status IN (1, 2, 3) ORDER BY view_count DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT 5
